messages:
katie_partnerships: Quick heads-up — ThirdWave partner wants to confirm press window + SI cutover timing so they can schedule their marketplace listing. Can we lock a 48hr window for press + 2hr cutover slot for SI?

sam_marketing: +1. What dates are they proposing? we should avoid Tue mornings bc of all-hands. :calendar:

katie_partnerships: They suggested Apr 18-19 or Apr 25-26. Prefer Apr 25-26 from their PM, but Apr 18 might work if we can compress docs/QA.

aj_engineering: For the 2hr cutover we need staging freeze 6h prior. Devs will stand down then. Also need final asset bundle by EOD Apr 24 if we go Apr 25.

liam_platform: Infra note — Dedicated build of the catalog image is queued. If asset bundle arrives by EOD Apr 24 we can finish validation and schedule the rollout. Cutover plan:
```
# cutover steps (high-level)
1) freeze staging (6h before)
2) run smoke tests on staging
3) promote image to prod tag
4) run rolling restart for catalog svc
5) verify metrics + routing
```

liam_platform: Also can we reserve a hotline for the 2hr window? opsbot can create incident channel and invite required folks.

katie_partnerships: Yes please — @opsbot create-channel ThirdWave-cutover and add platform, engineering, marketing, partnerships. Also we need legal review for partner copy by Apr 22.

opsbot: Channel created: #thirdwave-cutover. Invited: liam_platform, aj_engineering, sam_marketing, katie_partnerships. Reminder: upload asset bundle to S3 path: s3://redwood-marketplace/thirdwave/assets (preserve filenames).

sam_marketing: I'll draft the press copy and share a shortlink to staging landing by Apr 23. Can someone confirm the landing template supports partner logos + regional variants?

aj_engineering: Landing supports logos and locale banners. If you supply: logo.svg, hero.jpg, copy_{en,fr,de}.md we'll wire it in. Keep images under 300KB.

katie_partnerships: Nice. To summarize action items:
- sam_marketing: press draft by Apr 23
- aj_engineering: landing integration + locale wiring by Apr 24
- liam_platform: infra validation and hotline setup
- legal: partner copy signoff by Apr 22
- partner PM: confirm final acceptance Apr 24 EOD

Anyone object to Apr 25-26 window?

sam_marketing: No objections from marketing. :thumbsup:

aj_engineering: No objections — will block calendar.

liam_platform: Good to go from infra side.

katie_partnerships: Great — locking Apr 25-26 press + 2hr cutover on Apr 26 15:00-17:00 UTC. Will follow up with formal calendar invites and the hotline link. Thanks everyone! :party_parrot:
